files.installs/abiotic/gamedash-test-run.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Abiotic Factor server — generated by provision().
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
export WINEPREFIX="<ROOT>/home/.wine-gd-abiotic-test"
export WINEDEBUG=-all
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="   # no Mono/Gecko install prompts (headless)
# Run headless: Wine would otherwise open a console window on the desktop
# session (unsetting DISPLAY alone isn't enough — it falls back to Wayland).
unset DISPLAY
export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-none
cd "<ROOT>/installs/abiotic/AbioticFactor/Binaries/Win64" || exit 1
exec wine AbioticFactorServer-Win64-Shipping.exe \
    -log -LOG=gamedash-test.log -useperfthreads -NoAsyncLoadingThread \
    -MaxServerPlayers=6 -PORT=7784 -QueryPort=27030 \
    -ServerPassword="$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" \
    -AdminPassword="$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" \
    -SteamServerName="Test World" \
    -WorldSaveName=test -SandboxIniPath=Config/WindowsServer/gamedash-test-Sandbox.ini -tcp
